description: Discriminated union for POST /v3/videos request body.

oneOf.description:
Create a video from a HeyGen avatar (video or photo avatar).

Provide an avatar_id to use a previously created avatar. Supports all
avatar types: studio_avatar, digital_twin, and photo_avatar. Optionally
set ``engine`` to select Avatar V for eligible avatars; when omitted, the
server defaults to Avatar IV.

aspect_ratio.description: Output video aspect ratio. Supported values: '16:9', '9:16', '4:5', '5:4', '1:1', 'auto'. Defaults to '16:9'. 'auto' preserves the source's aspect ratio (avatar source frames or uploaded image), short-edge anchored to the requested resolution and capped at the tier's long edge. Falls back to '16:9' when source dimensions can't be read.

audio_asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID of an uploaded audio file. Mutually exclusive with script.

audio_url.description: Public URL of an audio file to lip-sync. Mutually exclusive with script.

avatar_id.description: HeyGen avatar ID (video avatar or photo avatar look ID).

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID of the background image. Used when type is 'image'. Mutually exclusive with url.

type.description: Background type. 'color' uses a solid hex color; 'image' uses an image from url or asset_id.

url.description: URL of the background image. Used when type is 'image'. Mutually exclusive with asset_id.

value.description: Hex color code (e.g. '#ff0000'). Required when type is 'color'.

brand_glossary_id.description: Brand glossary ID controlling how custom terms are pronounced in generated speech (for example, saying 'HeyGen' as 'hey-jen'). Applies when the audio is synthesized from `script`; a caller-supplied `audio_url` or `audio_asset_id` is unaffected. Pronunciation is applied to the synthesized audio only, so caption and subtitle text still show the original script wording. Discover IDs via GET /v3/brand-glossaries.

callback_id.description: Caller-defined identifier echoed back in the webhook payload.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL to receive a POST notification when the video is ready.

caption.description: Caption generation settings. A sidecar subtitle file is always returned via subtitle_url; set 'style' to additionally burn captions into the rendered video.

file_format.description: Output format for the sidecar caption file.

style.description: Visual style for burning captions into the rendered video. Omit for sidecar-only captions.

engine.description: Engine configuration for video generation. Pass {"type": "avatar_v"} to enable cross-reference-driven animation for higher quality. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility. Defaults to Avatar IV when omitted.

oneOf.description: Avatar V engine configuration with cross-reference-driven animation.

reference_look_id.description: Optional look to use as the animation reference. When provided, it must be a `digital_twin` look accessible to your workspace and in the same avatar group as `avatar_id` (`studio_avatar` and `photo_avatar` looks are rejected). When omitted, video avatars self-reference and photo avatars select from their group's eligible candidates, preferring digital twins (ready first, then processing / upgrading), then curated public studio looks. A photo avatar whose group has no eligible reference renders directly from its image without one; motion_prompt is rejected in that case. A non-public `digital_twin` reference, whether provided or selected automatically, must also satisfy its group's consent requirements.

type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'avatar_v'. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility.

oneOf.description: Avatar IV engine configuration (default behavior).

Avatar III engine configuration.

A single engine value that resolves to the right product by the avatar's
look type (mirrors how ``avatar_iv`` already serves both photo and video
avatars):

- video avatar looks (``digital_twin``, ``studio_avatar``) -> Digital Twin
  (supports 4K)
- ``photo_avatar`` look -> Photo Avatar (no 4K output)

Not supported for raw image input (``type: "image"``).
``motion_prompt`` and ``expressiveness`` are not supported with this engine.

type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'avatar_iii'. Resolves to Digital Twin for video avatar looks (digital_twin, studio_avatar) and Photo Avatar for photo_avatar looks; not supported for raw image input. Check supported_api_engines on the avatar look to confirm eligibility.

expressiveness.description: Avatar expressiveness level. Photo avatars only. Defaults to 'low' when omitted. Avatar IV only; rejected when engine.type is 'avatar_v'.

fit.description: How the subject is fitted to the output canvas. 'cover' scales to fill the frame (may crop edges). 'contain' scales to fit entirely within the frame (may show background). When omitted, the server picks the best option based on the source and canvas orientations.

folder_id.description: Destination folder ID in the caller's workspace. Omit, pass null, or pass an empty string to place the video at the workspace root. Supported only for single-video creation; batch video items cannot set their own destination folder.

motion_prompt.description: Natural-language prompt controlling avatar body motion and hand gestures. Supported for photo avatars on either engine, and for video avatars when engine.type is 'avatar_v'. Rejected for video avatars on the default Avatar IV engine, and for photo avatars on 'avatar_v' when the avatar's group has no animation reference (no digital twin or curated reference look).

output_format.description: Output container. 'webm' returns a video with a transparent background (alpha channel); 'mp4' (default) returns a standard video. 'webm' requires an avatar that supports matting. When 'webm' is selected, any 'background' value is rejected and background removal is applied automatically — the caller does not need to set 'remove_background'.

remove_background.description: Remove the avatar background. Video avatars must be trained with matting enabled.

script.description: Text script for the avatar to speak. Pair with voice_id, or omit voice_id when using avatar_id to use the avatar's default voice. Mutually exclusive with audio_url/audio_asset_id.

oneOf.description:
A whole-frame scene backed by an existing video clip.

Optional ``playback`` exposes the audio volume / mute capability; when
omitted the clip plays at its source volume.

For optional voiceover / narration, supply at most one audio source
(``script`` + ``voice_id``, ``audio_url``, or ``audio_asset_id``) — the *same*
audio inputs a narrated ``image`` scene accepts. When present, the narration
drives the scene length and ``playback.mode`` controls whether the clip
freezes, loops, or changes speed to fit that duration. When omitted the clip
plays full-length as before. The clip's own audio level is still governed by
``playback`` (the two compose).

audio_asset_id.description: Optional voiceover: HeyGen asset ID of an uploaded audio file. Mutually exclusive with script/audio_url.

audio_url.description: Optional voiceover: public URL of an audio file to play over the clip. Mutually exclusive with script/audio_asset_id.

playback.description: Optional playback capability: narrated-clip alignment 'mode', audio 'volume' (0.0–1.0), and 'mute'. Omit to use freeze alignment and keep the clip's source volume.

mode.description: How a narrated clip aligns to the voiceover-driven scene duration. 'freeze' plays once and holds the last frame; 'loop' repeats the clip; 'fit_to_scene' adjusts playback speed to exactly match the scene. Defaults to 'freeze' when omitted. Requires a video-scene voiceover.

mute.description: If True, force the clip silent regardless of 'volume'.

volume.description: Clip audio volume. 1.0 = source level (default), 0.0 = silent.

script.description: Optional voiceover: text to speak over the clip. Pair with voice_id. Mutually exclusive with audio_url/audio_asset_id.

source.description: Video clip to include. Accepts URL, asset ID, or base64-encoded data.

oneOf.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset

oneOf.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint

oneOf.description: Asset input via base64-encoded content.

media_type.description: MIME type of the encoded content (e.g. "image/png")

type.description: Must be 'video' for a video-clip scene.

voice_id.description: Voice ID for text-to-speech. Required when script is provided.

voice_settings.description: Voice tuning parameters (speed, pitch, locale) for a script voiceover.

engine_settings.description: Engine-specific voice tuning, discriminated by 'engine_type'. Use the variant matching the engine backing the chosen voice (e.g. engine_type='elevenlabs' for ElevenLabs-backed voices). The request is rejected if the voice_id is not compatible with the selected engine.

oneOf.description:
Engine-specific voice settings for ElevenLabs-backed voices.

Supports model, stability, similarity_boost, style, and use_speaker_boost.
When using eleven_v3, stability must be 0, 0.5, or 1.

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'elevenlabs' for ElevenLabs-backed voices.

model.description: The model ID to use for ElevenLabs.

similarity_boost.description: The similarity boost parameter for ElevenLabs.

use_speaker_boost.description: Whether to use speaker boost for ElevenLabs.

oneOf.description:
Engine-specific voice settings for Fish Audio-backed voices.

Inherits Fish's tuning fields (model, stability, similarity).

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'fish' for Fish Audio-backed voices.

similarity.description: Similarity parameter; how closely to match the source voice.

stability.description: Stability parameter; higher is more consistent.

oneOf.description:
Engine-selection for Starfish-backed voices.

Starfish has no user-tunable settings today; set ``engine_type='starfish'`` to force
Starfish routing on voices that support multiple engines.

engine_type.description: Engine type discriminator. Must be 'starfish' for Starfish-backed voices.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. 0.5 (half speed) to 1.5 (1.5x speed).

volume.description: Voice audio volume. 1.0 = full, 0.0 = silent. Useful when mixing spoken voice with background audio.

title.description: Display title for the video in the HeyGen dashboard.

type.description: Must be 'studio' for scene-composition video creation.

watermark.description: Custom watermark image to overlay on the video (PNG or JPEG). Available as a premium option for select Enterprise customers. To request access, please contact our support team.

image.description: Image asset to use as the watermark overlay (PNG or JPEG).

oneOf.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset

oneOf.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint

oneOf.description: Asset input via base64-encoded content.

media_type.description: MIME type of the encoded content (e.g. "image/png")

opacity.description: Watermark opacity. 0.0 is fully transparent, 1.0 is fully opaque.

placement.description: Watermark placement. Defaults to bottom-right with standard margins when omitted.

offset_x.description: Fine-tune horizontal position. Fraction of frame width; 0.05 shifts 5% rightward, -0.05 shifts 5% leftward.

offset_y.description: Fine-tune vertical position. Fraction of frame height; 0.05 shifts 5% downward, -0.05 shifts 5% upward.

scale.description: Scale multiplier for the watermark image. 1.0 renders at native size.
